title: Lakeside College public launch
text:
Open Pairly to all Lakeside students at the start of the spring semester (first week of classes is when people form study groups).

*   Launch email + posts in course group chats via the ambassador
*   Table at the student center on day one, bring the leftover stickers from Westbrook
*   Send the numbers to Maya at the end of week one for the Harbor Seed Fund update
